description: Add the (non-triggered) GitHub Pages deploy workflow, verify every item from design.md section 8's extraction list has actually landed in the Astro source tree, delete the Jekyll source tree only after that verification passes, and run a final clean-room build verification. Depends on FEAT-001 being complete (the Astro site must already exist and build before anything Jekyll-only can be safely deleted).
steps: Confirm the repo's default branch is `main` (already verified during planning via `git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` -> refs/remotes/origin/main; re-confirm if anything seems off).

Re-verify the current withastro/action tag and required inputs against https://github.com/withastro/action (design.md recorded v6.1.3 at design time - re-pin to whatever is current). Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: triggers on push to main and workflow_dispatch; permissions contents:read, pages:write, id-token:write; concurrency group "pages" with cancel-in-progress:false; a build job using actions/checkout@v4 then withastro/action@v6 (or current major); a deploy job needing build, using actions/deploy-pages@v4 with the github-pages environment. Do NOT commit a workflow that pushes anything, and do NOT run/trigger this workflow or push the branch.

Extraction completeness gate (verify before deleting anything): re-read src/consts.ts, src/pages/about.astro, src/pages/404.astro, public/CNAME, public/favicon.png, public/images/me.jpeg, and both src/content/blog/*/index.md files, cross-checking each against its corresponding design.md section 8 source item. Confirm FEAT-001's status is 'completed' and its findings don't flag anything incomplete. Do not proceed to deletion if any item is missing.

Delete the Jekyll files now that extraction is verified: Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, _config.yml, _includes/, _layouts/, _sass/, _data/, _pages/, _posts/, _drafts/, the root index.html, .gitpod.yml, and the Minimal-Mistakes-specific assets/ subpaths (assets/css/main.scss, assets/js/) plus the now fully-extracted assets/images/ directory as a whole (its needed contents were already copied into src/content/blog/*/, public/images/, and public/favicon.png by FEAT-001; the orphaned images noted in design.md section 8 step 1 are intentionally discarded, not copied anywhere).
Run `npm run build` again after deletion to confirm nothing in the Astro build still depended on a deleted Jekyll file.
Run the final full clean-room verification: `rm -rf dist .astro node_modules && npm install && npm run build`.
Commit the Jekyll deletions and the new workflow file locally on the `migrate-astro` branch (do not push).
acceptance_criteria: .github/workflows/deploy.yml exists, is valid YAML, and is not executed/triggered
git status shows only deletions of the listed Jekyll paths plus the already-added Astro source tree - no leftover Jekyll files
A clean-room `npm install && npm run build` succeeds with exit code 0 after the Jekyll deletion
dist/ after the clean-room build contains: both post pages, a posts listing page, sitemap.xml/sitemap-index.xml, rss.xml, OG meta tags in both post pages, and dist/CNAME with content 'mohashi.io'
verification: python3 -c "import yaml,sys; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/deploy.yml'))" — confirm no parse error (or an equivalent yamllint check)
git status --porcelain — confirm only the expected Jekyll-path deletions and Astro additions appear, nothing else
rm -rf dist .astro node_modules && npm install && npm run build — confirm exit code 0
ls dist/sitemap-index.xml dist/rss.xml dist/CNAME — confirm all exist; cat dist/CNAME — confirm content is 'mohashi.io'
grep -o '<meta property="og:[a-z:]*"' on both post pages in dist/ — confirm og:title/og:description/og:image present
findings:
All acceptance criteria and verification steps pass.

Deploy workflow: created .github/workflows/deploy.yml exactly per design.md section 7. withastro/action re-verified at implementation time against https://github.com/withastro/action/releases/latest - the current latest release is STILL v6.1.3 (unchanged from design time), so the action is pinned to the `v6` major tag (`uses: withastro/action@v6`) as the design specified. Other pinned versions: actions/checkout@v4, actions/deploy-pages@v4. Triggers: push to `main` + workflow_dispatch; permissions contents:read/pages:write/id-token:write; concurrency group "pages" with cancel-in-progress:false. The workflow was NOT triggered, NOT run, and the branch was NOT pushed. YAML validated clean (parsed by Ruby's YAML.load_file; pyyaml/yamllint were not installed, Ruby was used instead).

Default branch confirmed `main` (git symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD -> refs/remotes/origin/main), matching the workflow's `branches: [main]` trigger.

MANUAL STEP THE USER STILL MUST PERFORM (cannot be done by a workflow file alone): In the GitHub repo settings, switch the GitHub Pages source from "Deploy from a branch" to "GitHub Actions" (Settings > Pages > Build and deployment > Source = GitHub Actions). Until this is done, the deploy.yml workflow will fail at the deploy-pages step. This is a repo-settings change (UI or `gh api`), explicitly out of scope for this code-only task. The custom domain (mohashi.io) needs no change: dist/CNAME is produced from public/CNAME and preserves the domain.

Extraction completeness gate (verified before any deletion): src/consts.ts, src/pages/about.astro, src/pages/404.astro, public/CNAME (content exactly 'mohashi.io'), public/favicon.png, public/images/me.jpeg all present; both src/content/blog/*/index.mdx present with their images (quick-start-knative has knative.png, quakus-app-web-browser.png, unsplash-image-1.jpg and correctly does NOT contain the orphaned quickstart-knative-webconsole.gif; how-to-build-cloud-native-pipelines has all 12 image files + index.mdx). FEAT-001 status is 'completed' and its findings flag nothing incomplete.

Jekyll deletion: removed via `git rm -r` - Gemfile, Gemfile.lock, _config.yml, _includes/, _layouts/, _sass/, _data/, _pages/, _posts/, _drafts/, root index.html, .gitpod.yml, and the entire assets/ directory (which contained the Minimal-Mistakes assets/css/main.scss and assets/js/ plus the already-extracted assets/images/). git status shows 155 staged deletions, all Jekyll paths; the only non-Jekyll changes are the new untracked .github/ (the workflow) and .agents/ (task tracking) - no unexpected files touched.

NOTE on root CNAME: the repo's root-level `CNAME` file (tracked, content 'mohashi.io') was intentionally LEFT IN PLACE. design.md section 8 / FEAT-002's deletion list enumerate specific Jekyll paths to delete and do NOT include the root CNAME - it was copied to public/CNAME (which is what produces dist/CNAME), and a root CNAME is harmless/conventional for GitHub Pages. If a later cleanup wants the root CNAME gone to avoid duplication, that is a separate decision; it does not affect the build or deploy (dist/CNAME comes solely from public/CNAME).

Build verification: post-deletion `npm run build` exit 0 (nothing in the Astro build depended on a deleted Jekyll file). Final clean-room `rm -rf dist .astro node_modules && npm install && npm run build` exit 0 (npm install reported 0 vulnerabilities). dist/ contains both post pages, dist/posts/index.html listing, dist/sitemap-index.xml, dist/sitemap-0.xml, dist/rss.xml, dist/CNAME (content 'mohashi.io'), dist/favicon.png, dist/images/me.jpeg; og:title/og:description/og:image (plus og:type/og:url) present in both post pages.

Node: ambient default is v10.24.1 (incompatible with Astro 7). Used nvm to activate v22.23.3 (satisfies the >=22.22.0 engine constraint that create-astro@5.3.0 and the installed astro@7.4.1 actually require, per FEAT-001's findings) before every npm command. The deploy.yml relies on withastro/action's internal Node setup; if a Node version ever needs pinning there, target 22.22+ (18.x / plain 20.x will not work with what is installed).
